I am seventy-seven years old and never went to school, so I farm the way my father taught me and listen to the extension workers when they come. This plot is rented and only 0.17 hectares, but it is my main field for maize, and I intercrop with pigeon pea to keep the soil from getting too tired. I will use the improved maize seed and the subsidized fertilizer coupons from the government program, because without them the harvest would be very poor on this small piece of land. I cannot afford pesticides or hired workers when my family can help with the weeding and harvesting, and there is no water here for irrigation, so we depend entirely on the rains.
